args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in requirements.txt.

## Security
- **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Affected versions: <2.9.4 (2.x line) and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0.
- 2.9.4 is the fixed release on the current 2.x line; no other dependencies changed.

## Testing
- CI on the branch (commit c8b8ab7878, run ci-0001) passed.
